name: phil/audit-bundle
description: An audit trail for Symfony that shows any tampering and still lets you erase personal information: append-only, hash-chained, read a page at a time.

suggest.doctrine/dbal: To keep the trail in a table of a Doctrine connection
suggest.phil/tenancy-bundle: To stamp each row with the active tenant and hold reading to it
suggest.phil/url: To read the collector's endpoint (feed.otlp), with symfony/http-client
suggest.symfony/http-client: To send the facts to an OpenTelemetry collector (feed.otlp)
suggest.symfony/messenger: To dispatch each recorded row to dashboards (dispatch_bus)
suggest.symfony/security-core: To name the current account in the rows the bundle records
suggest.symfony/workflow: To record the transitions of Auditable subjects (workflow_segment)
